component.name: sshTIK
component.summary: SSH terminal with pop-up SFTP and MySQL helpers

description.p: sshTIK is a plain SSH terminal until you need more. Press F5 and a dual-pane file transfer window opens, already sitting in the directory your remote shell is in. Press F6 while you are at a mysql prompt and a database browser opens on the same connection, with an editable data grid, table structure and query history.
Everything runs over the single SSH connection you already authenticated: no second login, no separate FTP server, no tunnels to configure.

ul.li: Tabbed VTE terminal with saved hosts and ~/.ssh/config integration
SFTP file manager with drag-and-drop, recursive transfers and edit-remote-file-locally
MySQL/MariaDB browser that picks up the client you already launched
